sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stray Dogs is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day to you, soldier. Though could I actually say it's good? As a wise person used to say, people are made to torment each other. When I first read it, I didn't honestly believe it. But now my heart bleeds every time I remember this quote. Some new renegades are terrorizing the city. I've sent a man to negotiate with them, maybe even guide them to the right path, but those savages decapitated him and sent his head back to me, with the letter I wrote for them... They're not locals, all came from USEC. Long renounced from their own people too. They must be hunted down. This is our land. No more peace talks."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 35 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and eliminate Knight
- Locate and eliminate Big Pipe
- Locate and eliminate Birdeye

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +35,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 230,000 Roubles
  - 241,500 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 264,500 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- 1× S I C C organizational pouch
- 1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle
- 2× Mk-18 .338 LM 10-round magazine
- 1× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
"Don't think about your hands getting bloody again, soldier. Think that you have cleared this land of the wicked."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill Knight, Big Pipe and Birdeye.
